support.note: The engine's live catalog projection omitted this model's metadata, but the engine's own Models.dev catalog publishes low, high, max for it. Mona offers only those published values.

declared.note: Auto is the engine's own default: its reasoning selector resolves a concrete tier for each turn. Mona sends it explicitly and does not offer a different setting here, so the value is declared rather than implied.

inheritance.note: Mona declares `auto` and sends it on every new thread and turn, so the engine's reasoning selector resolves a concrete tier for each turn. That tier is not reported back, so the effective value stays unknown; the request is not proof of what the provider did. Because Mona sends `auto` explicitly, the engine's own configured default does not govern this route.

display.note: Mona renders the reasoning items the engine streams. This preference changes Mona's transcript only; it is never sent to the engine and it does not change thinking or effort.

saved.note: Saved new-thread default; validated against the live provider and model catalog.
